metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Nassau County, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentrations over Nassau County, New York for: - October 1-23, 2021 vs same period in 2019 and 2018 For NO2 data, I should use: - Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data (collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') - Time periods: Oct 1-23 for each year (2018, 2019, 2021) - Location: Nassau County, New York The data structure: - Collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' - Band: 'NO2_column_number_density' (tropospheric NO2 vertical column density) - These are L3 products already processed, so cloud masking not needed Strategy: 1. Define geometry for Nassau County, NY 2. Get NO2 data for each time period 3. Calculate mean NO2 for each period 4. Compare 2021 vs 2019 and 2018 5. Check if 2021 is lower than both previous years Need to handle: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist (C2) - Validate results are reasonable (C3) - Output A if 2021 < 2019 AND 2021 < 2018, else B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions nassau_county = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-73.700, 40.640], [-73.700, 40.870], [-73.460, 40.870], [-73.460, 40.640] ]]) # Define time periods periods = { '2018': ('2018-10-01', '2018-10-24'), '2019': ('2019-10-01', '2019-10-24'), '2021': ('2021-10-01', '2021-10-24') } # 2. Data Acquisition & Processing results = {} pixel_counts = {} for year, (start_date, end_date) in periods.items(): # Get NO2 collection no2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(nassau_county) \ .select('NO2_column_number_density') # Check if collection is empty if no2_col.size().getInfo() == 0: print(f"{year} Images: 0") results[year] = None pixel_counts[year] = 0 continue # Create mean composite mean_no2 = no2_col.mean() # Get pixel count and mean value stats = mean_no2.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True), geometry=nassau_county, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) mean_val = stats.get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo() count = stats.get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo() results[year] = mean_val pixel_counts[year] = count print(f"{year} Images: {no2_col.size().getInfo()} (Mean: {mean_val:.6f}, Pixels: {int(count)})") # 3. Validation & Final Answer if None in results.values(): print("C1") elif any(count == 0 for count in pixel_counts.values()): print("C2") elif any(val is None or val < 0 or val > 1e-5 for val in results.values() if val is not None): print("C3") else: # Check if 2021 is lower than both 2019 and 2018 no2_2021 = results['2021'] no2_2019 = results['2019'] no2_2018 = results['2018'] if no2_2021 < no2_2019 and no2_2021 < no2_2018: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
nassau_county = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-73.700, 40.640], [-73.700, 40.870], 
    [-73.460, 40.870], [-73.460, 40.640]
]])

# Define time periods
periods = {
    '2018': ('2018-10-01', '2018-10-24'),
    '2019': ('2019-10-01', '2019-10-24'), 
    '2021': ('2021-10-01', '2021-10-24')
}

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
results = {}
pixel_counts = {}

for year, (start_date, end_date) in periods.items():
    # Get NO2 collection
    no2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(nassau_county) \
        .select('NO2_column_number_density')
    
    # Check if collection is empty
    if no2_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"{year} Images: 0")
        results[year] = None
        pixel_counts[year] = 0
        continue
    
    # Create mean composite
    mean_no2 = no2_col.mean()
    
    # Get pixel count and mean value
    stats = mean_no2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True),
        geometry=nassau_county,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    mean_val = stats.get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo()
    count = stats.get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo()
    
    results[year] = mean_val
    pixel_counts[year] = count
    
    print(f"{year} Images: {no2_col.size().getInfo()} (Mean: {mean_val:.6f}, Pixels: {int(count)})")

# 3. Validation & Final Answer
if None in results.values():
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif any(count == 0 for count in pixel_counts.values()):
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif any(val is None or val < 0 or val > 1e-5 for val in results.values() if val is not None):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    # Check if 2021 is lower than both 2019 and 2018
    no2_2021 = results['2021']
    no2_2019 = results['2019']
    no2_2018 = results['2018']
    
    if no2_2021 < no2_2019 and no2_2021 < no2_2018:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
